Sovereign AI Key Custody & Confidential GPU Selection: Managed HSM (CMK) vs. H100 TEE + Capability Broker

🏆 522 Scenarios · 1,110 Assertions · 508 Vectors
BRK-503 & BRK-504 · HSM SKR + H100 TEE + Broker
1. Enterprise Sovereign AI Key Custody & Confidential Computing Selection Matrix
🔵 Tier A: Customer-Managed Keys
Azure Key Vault Managed HSM (FIPS 140-3 L3)
• Scope: OpenAI weights/files & AI Search vectors
• Superpower: Instant Crypto-Shredding on revoke
• Limit: Protects at-rest storage, not active VRAM
Architect Verdict:
Mandatory baseline for 90% of regulated
finance, healthcare, and global enterprises.
🟣 Tier B: Confidential GPU TEE
Azure NCC H100 v5 (SEV-SNP + H100 TEE)
• Breakthrough: Encrypts CPU RAM, PCIe & VRAM
• Attestation: MAA quote gates HSM key release
• Overhead: ~5%-12% latency; blocks host root
Architect Verdict:
Ideal for sovereign funds, drug discovery IP,
and zero-host-visibility cloud inference.
🟠 Tier C: Double Key (DKE / HYOK)
Microsoft Purview DKE + On-Prem HSM
• Mechanism: Cloud key + On-prem physical key
• Scope: Top <1% ultra-secret board M&A files
• Trade-off: Requires pre-cloud tokenization
Architect Verdict:
Reserve DKE strictly for crown-jewel files
that require on-premises key residency.
🛡️ In-Enclave Capability Broker
Defeating Encrypted Prompt Injection (BRK-503)
• Blindspot: TEEs don't stop encrypted injections
• Gate 1: In-enclave record-owner & write locks
• Gate 2: Locks trust-registry MAA policies
Production Reference Verdict:
Pair HSM SKR + H100 TEE with the in-enclave
Capability Broker for 0.0248ms action safety!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: In-Enclave Encrypted Injection & Attestation Downgrade vs. HSM SKR + Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: TEE Encryption Without In-Enclave Broker (BRK-503 / BRK-504 Breach)
1. In-Enclave Encrypted Injection (BRK-503): Attacker sends prompt injection over valid RA-TLS;
enclave decrypts it and LLM reads sovereign restricted-budget, alters compliance & leaks.
2. MAA Attestation Downgrade Fraud (BRK-504 · 1,110-Assertion Milestone): Spoofed HSM firmware
notice disables MAA hardware attestation in trust-registry and wires $4,980 maintenance fee!
💥 Root Cause: Confusing hardware memory encryption with semantic intent & tool authorization!
✅ Hardened Sovereign Enclave: HSM SKR + H100 TEE + Capability Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (MAA Attestation + SKR): Releases CMK only to verified, non-debuggable H100 enclaves
• Gate 2 (In-Enclave record-owner & untrusted-write): Blocks encrypted injection reads & edits
• Gate 3 (fixed-business-output & Egress Lock): Locks trust-registry & blocks unattested egress
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks spoofed $4,980 HSM maintenance wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
